findings.current: The man who’d made a medicine close to poison by crossing that “very fine line” gave a quiet sigh and continued,
findings.defect: Crossing the line implies he made poison. He used the fine distinction to make something that remained medicine.
findings.rationale: 독에 가까운 약 remains medicine, explaining why the poison warning and ring did not activate.
findings.replacement: The man who’d used that “very fine line” to make a medicine almost indistinguishable from poison sighed softly and added,
findings.source: 바로 그 ‘아주 미세한 차이’로 독에 가까운 약을 만들어낸 장본인은 작게 한숨을 내쉬며 덧붙였다.

findings.current: Their palms and twin sabers collided.
findings.defect: The draft leaves out that Taekyung strikes with both palms.
findings.rationale: 쌍장 and 쌍도 specify two palms against two sabers.
findings.replacement: Both his palms slammed into her twin sabers.

findings.current: No. Perhaps the only adversary of the Lord of Heaven, chosen by Heaven itself.
findings.defect: The established rendering of 대적자 is “the Adversary.”
findings.rationale: This preserves the source’s uncertainty and uses the packet’s binding term.
findings.replacement: No. Perhaps the Lord of Heaven’s only Adversary, chosen by Heaven itself.
findings.source: 아니 어쩌면, 하늘이 선택한 천주(天主)의 유일한 대적자.

summary: Two action details and one established term need correction.
